_start-investing_.q: How do I start investing with Evolve Venture Capital?
_start-investing_.a: To begin investing, simply reach out to us through our website or contact form. Our team will guide you through the process, including selecting investment opportunities aligned with your goals and risk preferences.

_start-investing_.q: What types of investments does Evolve Venture Capital focus on?
_start-investing_.a: We specialize in providing capital to high-potential startups across diverse industries, with a focus on sustainability, technology, and innovation. Our portfolio includes early-stage and growth-stage businesses with scalable models and strong market potential.

_start-investing_.q: How does Evolve Venture Capital evaluate investment opportunities?
_start-investing_.a: We carefully assess each investment opportunity based on factors such as market potential, financial performance, management teams, and alignment with our investment thesis. We conduct thorough due diligence to ensure that every investment aligns with our goals and values.

_start-investing_.q: What is the minimum investment amount?
_start-investing_.a: The minimum investment amount depends on the specific opportunity and the terms agreed upon. Our team will discuss available opportunities and help you determine the best investment size based on your portfolio and objectives.

_start-investing_.q: Can I invest in startups at different stages of growth?
_start-investing_.a: Yes, we offer opportunities to invest in both early-stage and growth-stage companies. Whether you’re looking to support innovative startups or partner with established businesses aiming for expansion, we have a range of options tailored to different investor preferences.

_start-investing_.q: What kind of support will I receive after making an investment?
_start-investing_.a: Beyond providing capital, Evolve Venture Capital offers strategic guidance, access to our network of industry experts, and insights to help maximize the growth potential of your investment. We believe in fostering long-term relationships with our investors and ensuring their success.

_start-investing_.q: What is the expected return on investment (ROI)?
_start-investing_.a: The ROI varies depending on the investment opportunity, stage of the business, and industry. Our team works closely with portfolio companies to ensure that investments are positioned for growth, with a focus on maximizing returns over the long term.

_start-investing_.q: How do I track the progress of my investment?
_start-investing_.a: Investors are kept up-to-date through regular performance reports, investor meetings, and updates from the companies in which they’ve invested. We provide transparency and ongoing communication to ensure that you can track your investments and assess their performance.

_start-investing_.q: Can I exit an investment early?
_start-investing_.a: Exiting investments before the anticipated term is possible, but it depends on the specific terms of the deal and market conditions. Our team will discuss exit strategies with you and provide guidance on the best approach for your investment.

_start-investing_.q: How can I get in touch for personalized investment advice?
_start-investing_.a: For personalized advice, you can schedule a consultation with one of our experienced investment advisors through the contact form on our website. We’ll help you explore opportunities that align with your financial goals and risk appetite.

_raise-capital_.q: How can I raise capital through Evolve Venture Capital?
_raise-capital_.a: To raise capital, submit your pitch through our online platform or contact form. Once we receive your pitch, our team will review it, assess the opportunity, and determine the best funding solutions that align with your business goals.

_raise-capital_.q: What types of startups can apply for funding?
_raise-capital_.a: We consider startups across various industries, especially those with innovative solutions and scalable growth potential. Whether you are in the tech, healthcare, sustainability, or consumer goods sectors, we’re interested in companies that have a clear business model and strong growth prospects.

_raise-capital_.q: What is the process for submitting a pitch?
_raise-capital_.a: The pitch submission process is simple: submit your business plan, financial projections, and relevant documents through our pitch submission form. Our team will evaluate your proposal and get in touch to discuss next steps.

_raise-capital_.q: How do you evaluate the startup funding proposals?
_raise-capital_.a: We evaluate proposals based on a variety of factors, including market opportunity, product or service viability, management team expertise, scalability, and financial performance. We also consider the alignment with our investment strategy for sustainable and high-growth ventures.

_raise-capital_.q: What are the different types of funding options available?
_raise-capital_.a: We offer various funding options including equity investment, convertible notes, and venture debt. Our team will discuss the best funding structure based on your business stage and capital needs.

_raise-capital_.q: How much capital can I raise through Evolve Venture Capital?
_raise-capital_.a: The amount of capital available depends on your business needs and the opportunity we identify. We typically work with companies looking to raise capital ranging from early-stage seed funding to growth capital for scaling.

_raise-capital_.q: Do you require a specific revenue level or traction before funding?
_raise-capital_.a: While a proven track record of revenue or traction can strengthen your pitch, we also work with early-stage startups with strong potential and an innovative idea. Our team looks at the overall business model, market fit, and growth potential.

_raise-capital_.q: How long does it take to secure funding?
_raise-capital_.a: The time to secure funding varies depending on the complexity of the deal and the type of funding you’re seeking. Typically, after submitting your pitch, it takes about 4-6 weeks to complete due diligence and finalize the funding agreement.

_raise-capital_.q: Will I have to give up control of my business?
_raise-capital_.a: In some funding scenarios, particularly equity investment, you may have to give up a percentage of ownership in your business. However, our goal is to support your growth, and we work to ensure that your interests and vision remain a priority.

_raise-capital_.q: How can I get support after receiving funding?
_raise-capital_.a: After securing funding, Evolve Venture Capital provides ongoing support through mentorship, strategic guidance, and access to a network of industry professionals to help scale your business. Our team is committed to your success and works with you to achieve sustainable growth.

_investor-faqs_.q: What makes Evolve VC unique in Asian markets?
_investor-faqs_.a: We are the only Singapore-based Venture Capital firm with physical offices in Hyderabad and Guntur, India — giving us genuine on-the-ground insight in two of Asia's most dynamic startup markets. We invest across sectors (not just one), we lead funding rounds (not just follow), and we stay actively involved after investment through our mentorship programme. There are no invented frameworks here — just real relationships with founders and investors.

_investor-faqs_.q: Which high-growth sectors do you prioritize?
_investor-faqs_.a: We focus on AI and Machine Learning, Fintech and Payments, HealthTech, CleanTech, and Enterprise SaaS. We particularly look for companies that can scale across Southeast Asia and India — businesses solving a regional problem, not just a local one. If you are building in one of these sectors and see a genuinely large addressable market, we would love to hear from you.

_investor-faqs_.q: What's your geographic investment strategy?
_investor-faqs_.a: 70% of capital targets Singapore, India (Tier 1-3 cities), Malaysia, UAE (Dubai), UK, and USA. We leverage local teams for market insights: India's consumer tech boom, UAE's tax-free zones, and Singapore's deep tech corridor – ensuring compliance and rapid scaling.

_investor-faqs_.q: Which startup stages do you fund?
_investor-faqs_.a: We invest from Pre-Seed ($250K-$1M) to Series C ($5M-$20M), with 60% allocated to Seed/Series A. Focus on India/Southeast Asian startups showing 10% MoM revenue growth, proven unit economics, and capital-efficient scaling in high-potential tech sectors.

_investor-faqs_.q: Do you lead investment rounds?
_investor-faqs_.a: Yes, we lead 80% of initial rounds in portfolio companies, structuring founder-friendly term sheets with balanced governance. Specializing in cross-border syndicates, we connect Indian/Singaporean startups with UAE/US co-investors for follow-on funding at premium valuations.

_investor-faqs_.q: How does your team's expertise benefit startups?
_investor-faqs_.a: Partners include ex-entrepreneurs from Grab, Paytm, and Careem with hyperlocal operational experience across 6 target markets. We provide hands-on scaling playbooks for India's consumer apps, UAE's fintech regulations, and Malaysia's manufacturing logistics.

_investor-faqs_.q: How do I submit my startup for funding?
_investor-faqs_.a: Use our online portal for pitch decks. Required: financial projections, cap table, and market analysis. India/UAE-based startups receive feedback within 7 days. Priority for companies addressing ASEAN sustainability mandates or India's digital infrastructure gaps.

_investor-faqs_.q: What are key due diligence focus areas?
_investor-faqs_.a: We prioritize: 1) TAM (Total Addressable Market) >$500M in target regions 2) IP defensibility 3) Unit economics 4) Founder-market fit 5) Regulatory compliance. Third-party audits validate claims, with AI tools accelerating India/Singapore market validation.

_investor-faqs_.q: How long until funding disbursement?
_investor-faqs_.a: Term sheets issued in 2-3 weeks post-initial meeting. UAE/Singapore deals close fastest (25 days avg) due to streamlined regulations. Full due diligence takes 4-5 weeks with parallel legal/financial review for rapid deployment.

_investor-faqs_.q: What ownership stake do you require?
_investor-faqs_.a: Target 15-25% for Seed ($1-3M checks) and 10-20% for Growth stages. UAE/India deals include board observer rights with founder-controlled governance. Structures align incentives through milestone-based tranches.

_investor-faqs_.q: Do you use SAFE/convertible notes?
_investor-faqs_.a: Yes, 40% of early-stage deals use SAFE (Simple Agreement for Future Equity) notes with valuation caps. Preferred for India/Singapore pre-revenue startups. Convertible notes include UAE-specific Sharia-compliance clauses where required.

_investor-faqs_.q: What disqualifies startups during screening?
_investor-faqs_.a: Key red flags: weak unit economics (>12 mo CAC payback), fragmented cap tables, or non-compliance with India's DPDP (Digital Personal Data Protection) Act / UAE's ESG reporting requirements. Founders must demonstrate regional regulatory awareness.

_investor-faqs_.q: How do you assist with India/ASEAN market entry?
_investor-faqs_.a: Local teams navigate India's GST (Goods and Services Tax) systems, Singapore's PDPA (Personal Data Protection Act), and UAE's free zone regulations. We accelerate e-commerce licensing (e.g., India's ONDC integration) and fintech approvals in Malaysia – reducing setup time by 60%.

_investor-faqs_.q: Do you provide growth talent sourcing?
_investor-faqs_.a: Yes, we deploy dedicated talent scouts across Bangalore, Singapore, and Dubai. Connect startups with executives from Flipkart, SEA Group, and Careem. Portfolio companies fill leadership roles 50% faster than market averages through our network.

_investor-faqs_.q: How do you facilitate enterprise sales?
_investor-faqs_.a: Leverage partnerships with 30+ Fortune 500 corps (e.g., Tata Group in India, Emirates NBD in UAE). Run pilot programs with Singapore's Smart Nation initiative – driving 3x faster enterprise sales cycles for B2B SaaS startups.

_investor-faqs_.q: Can you help secure follow-on funding?
_investor-faqs_.a: Our finance team prepares Series A/B materials, introduces tier-1 VCs (e.g., Sequoia India, MEVP), and negotiates term sheets. Portfolio companies raise follow-on rounds at 2.3x higher valuations than regional benchmarks.

_investor-faqs_.q: What operational frameworks do you implement?
_investor-faqs_.a: Custom GTM (Go-to-Market) playbooks for India's multilingual markets, UAE's high-net-worth client targeting, and SaaS metric dashboards. Startups improve gross margins by 25% through our unit economics optimization system.

_investor-faqs_.q: How involved are you in governance?
_investor-faqs_.a: We take 1 board seat with focus on strategic guidance – not daily operations. Quarterly KPI reviews track India/SEA-specific metrics like cohort retention and regulatory compliance scores. Founders retain 85% voting control.

_investor-faqs_.q: What ROI targets do you set?
_investor-faqs_.a: Seed investments: 4-6x cash-on-cash returns in 5 years. Growth stage: 5-8x in 4-6 years. India/Singapore AI portfolios outperform at 7.2x avg. Returns enhanced through UAE/Singapore tax-efficient holding structures.

_investor-faqs_.q: What's your primary exit strategy?
_investor-faqs_.a: 65% strategic acquisitions (e.g., Indian edtech to Byju's), 25% IPOs (targeting India's NSE/BSE), 10% secondary sales. UAE exits leverage Dubai's IPO accelerator program for 30% faster public listings.

_investor-faqs_.q: How do you mitigate downside risk?
_investor-faqs_.a: Diversify across 6 geographies with sector caps. Use milestone-based funding tranches and 1x liquidation preferences. 20% allocation to lower-risk growth-stage startups in Singapore/Malaysia with positive EBITDA.

_investor-faqs_.q: What's your 2025 fund performance?
_investor-faqs_.a: Fund VII (2024) shows 4.8x MOIC (Multiple on Invested Capital). India portfolios lead at 6.1x. Climate tech bets in UAE/Singapore project 35% IRR (Internal Rate of Return) via carbon credit monetization.

_investor-faqs_.q: How do currency risks impact Asian investments?
_investor-faqs_.a: Hedge INR/USD and SGD/MYR volatility via forward contracts. Maintain 30% USD reserves for follow-ons. UAE investments use dirham-pegged structures to minimize forex exposure during exits.

_investor-faqs_.q: Do you facilitate secondary sales for founders?
_investor-faqs_.a: Yes, we structure partial liquidity events at Series B+ (typically 10-15% stake). Enabled 8 India/UAE founders to unlock $2M-$15M pre-exit while retaining control through dual-class shares.

_investor-faqs_.q: How can I invest as an LP?
_investor-faqs_.a: Accredited investors commit $250K+ via LP (Limited Partner) agreements. UAE/Singapore family offices access bespoke vehicles with quarterly distributions. Submit KYC (Know Your Customer) through our portal for fund docs and regional tax summaries.

_investor-faqs_.q: What reporting do LPs receive?
_investor-faqs_.a: Quarterly reports include TVPI (Total Value to Paid-In), DPI (Distributions to Paid-In), and regional performance breakdowns. Access real-time dashboards tracking India/UAE portfolio KPIs. Annual meetings in Dubai/Singapore with exit roadmaps.

_investor-faqs_.q: Are co-investment opportunities available?
_investor-faqs_.a: Yes, our SPV (Special Purpose Vehicle) platform offers $100K+ co-investments in high-conviction deals. 2024 UAE/UK co-investors achieved 48% net IRR across climate tech and fintech deals.

_investor-faqs_.q: How do you address ESG compliance?
_investor-faqs_.a: Mandate SFDR (Sustainable Finance Disclosure Regulation) Article 8 reporting. Track gender parity (40%+ female execs in portfolio) and CO2 reduction metrics. 35% allocation to UAE/India climate tech meeting UN SDGs (Sustainable Development Goals).

_investor-faqs_.q: What's your dry powder allocation?
_investor-faqs_.a: $180M deployable capital: 40% India, 20% SEA, 15% UAE, 15% USA/UK. Prioritize Seed rounds ($1-3M checks) in AI/ClimateTech with 8-10 deals/quarter across target regions.

_investor-faqs_.q: Do you use AI in portfolio management?
_investor-faqs_.a: Our EVA (Evolve Vision Analytics) platform predicts liquidity events using India/UAE market data. Automates KPI tracking with 92% forecast accuracy for Series A readiness and exit timing.

_investor-faqs_.q: What founder traits do you prioritize?
_investor-faqs_.a: Seek domain experts with 5+ years in regulated sectors (fintech, healthtech). Value resilience navigating India/ASEAN bureaucracies and cultural agility for cross-border scaling. 80% of funded founders have industry-specific exit experience.

_investor-faqs_.q: Can I retain control post-investment?
_investor-faqs_.a: Yes. Governance includes founder veto rights on key decisions, 4-year vesting schedules, and independent board seats. UAE/India deals feature enhanced founder protections via golden shares.

_investor-faqs_.q: How do you support technical hiring?
_investor-faqs_.a: Provide access to IIT (Indian Institutes of Technology)/NUS (National University of Singapore) talent pipelines and Dubai's global tech expat network. Cover 50% of recruitment fees for CTO/CPO roles during scaling phases.

_investor-faqs_.q: Do you help with regulatory licensing?
_investor-faqs_.a: Yes. Secure India's RBI (Reserve Bank of India) fintech approvals, UAE's ADGM (Abu Dhabi Global Market) licenses, and Singapore's MAS (Monetary Authority of Singapore) exemptions – accelerating market entry by 4-9 months.

_investor-faqs_.q: What mentorship do partners provide?
_investor-faqs_.a: Monthly sessions with operating partners: Ex-Paytm CMO on India user growth, Careem alumni on MENA expansion, and Grab veterans on SEA logistics optimization. Custom playbooks for each market.

_investor-faqs_.q: How do you resolve founder-investor conflicts?
_investor-faqs_.a: Proactive alignment via quarterly feedback sessions and independent advisory boards. Escalation path to neutral Singapore arbitration center. Zero forced founder replacements in 2023-2025 portfolio.
